extreme_fear.name: Extreme Fear Contrarian
extreme_fear.description: Buys when the Crypto Fear & Greed Index drops to 25 or below (Extreme Fear). Historically, extreme fear marks local bottoms because retail panic-sells while smart money accumulates. Backtest data (2018-2024) shows buying at F&G <= 20 yields a median 30-day return of +12% for BTC.
extreme_fear.edge: Mean reversion from retail panic selling

confidence_formula: confidence = base(0.55) + fear_bonus(0-0.15) + momentum_bonus(0-0.10). Max 0.80. Base is just above coin flip to be honest about uncertainty. Fear bonus scales with how extreme the Fear & Greed is. Momentum bonus scales with the size of the 24h price move.

closed_picks_recent.strategy_description: Triggers when a coin drops more than 10% in 24 hours. Large single-day drops tend to mean-revert within 3-7 days due to short covering and bargain hunting. Tighter targets and stops than extreme_fear because crash bounces are faster but less reliable.
closed_picks_recent.strategy_edge: Short squeeze + bargain hunting after >10% daily drop
closed_picks_recent.reason: XRP crashed -10.0% in 24h — mean reversion bounce expected

closed_picks_recent.strategy_description: Triggers when EMA(12) crosses below EMA(50) AND RSI shows bearish divergence (price making higher highs but RSI making lower highs). Research from altFINS shows 51.72% net profit on XRP/USDT 3H in the 2022 bear market. Works in bearish/ranging markets. Filtered by F&G < 40 to only trade in fearful conditions.
closed_picks_recent.strategy_edge: Trend reversal confirmation from momentum + moving average alignment
closed_picks_recent.reason: ETH EMA(12) crossed below EMA(50) on 4H + F&G=28 (Fear) + RSI=37.9 — bearish trend confirmed
